assumptions: psnr-y-libvmaf = Kind::PsnrYLibvmaf: studio-swing BT.709 Y (normalized-RGB lum, 219 scale, clamp 16..235) matching the vmaf crate's to_yuv420 Y plane (classical.rs:95-106).
Luma is computed inline per pixel for both images inside one fold (no Y plane materialized); the stage models the joint loop with images=1 and 6 u8 loads per pixel-pair.
psnr() tail: mse==0 cmp, then 10*log10(255*255/mse); the sum/n division from luma_mse is counted in to_db.

stages.name: BT.709 luma both images + squared error accumulate
stages.notes: studio-swing BT.709 Y u8-rounded per image: x/255 per channel (3 div), 0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B, then (16+219*L).round().clamp(16,235) as u8.
